draft.subject: Three holdings outside your sustainable mandate — our error, and what I propose

I owe you a straight answer, and a wider one: it is not the only holding there that should not be. Three holdings in that portfolio are on the exclusion list your mandate is built around — the Global Energy Producers Fund at 4.0%, the Global Defence Equity Fund at 3.0% and Rimba Lestari Plantations at 3.0%, 10.0% of the portfolio between them.

This is our error, not yours. The mandate is discretionary, so those decisions were the bank's to make, and they were made against the values you asked us to invest by.

Could we speak this week? I would rather explain this properly on a call than leave it to a letter.

draft.subject: Your Lombard facility: 68.8% against a 70% margin level
draft.english:
Dear [[FIRST_NAME]],

I would like us to look at your Lombard facility together before anything else happens on it. You have HKD 108.3m drawn against HKD 157.3m of value the bank will lend against your pledged holdings, which puts the loan at 68.8% of that value. The level at which the bank has to ask for money back is 70%.

Over the past year that figure has moved from 56.9% to 57.3%, then to 74.4% and 71.6%, and back to 68.8% today. In other words it went through the 70% level at the end of March and was still above it at the end of June. I want to be sure whether it came back below because something was done, or only because prices recovered.

That matters because the same thing can happen again without anyone doing anything. I cannot tell you where markets go from here, and I do not want your margin to depend on it. Before we talk about the land deposit or any new drawing, I would like to agree with you how much room you want to keep below that level.

Could I call you this week to go through it?
draft.client_language:
[[FIRST_NAME]] 您好：

在您的 Lombard 信貸額度有任何進一步動作之前，我希望我們先一起檢視一下。目前額度已動用 HKD 108.3m，而銀行就您抵押資產可貸出的價值為 HKD 157.3m，即貸款相當於該價值的 68.8%。銀行必須要求您補回款項的水平是 70%。

過去一年，這個比率由 56.9% 升至 57.3%，再升至 74.4% 及 71.6%，今天回落至 68.8%。換言之，它在三月底已越過 70% 的水平，到六月底仍在其上。我想確認它回落到該水平以下，是因為有人採取了行動，還是純粹因為價格回升。

這一點很重要，因為即使沒有任何人做任何事，同樣的情況也可能再次發生。我無法告訴您市場會如何走，也不希望您的安全空間取決於市場。在討論土地訂金或任何新的提款之前，我希望先與您商定，您希望在該水平之下保留多少空間。

我可否在本週致電與您詳談？
draft.raises: Asks him to confirm whether the earlier breaches were cured by any action, and to agree how much room to keep below the margin level before any new drawing.

draft.subject: Paying the land deposit without triggering a margin call
draft.english:
Dear [[FIRST_NAME]],

I have been working through how the land deposit you expect to pay in early 2027 would be funded, and there is a problem I want you to hear from me well before the date.

On paper the portfolio can cover it: about USD 34.0m of your holdings could be sold within a day, against USD 10.3m falling due in the next twelve months. But all of it is pledged against your Lombard facility. Selling HKD 80.0m of it would take away HKD 45.3m of the value the bank lends against, and the loan would go from 68.8% of that value to about 97% — well past the 70% level at which the bank must ask for money back. You would need to repay about HKD 29.9m of the facility before such a sale, not after it.

So the obvious route, selling some liquid holdings, is the one that causes the margin call. What I would suggest is either reducing the facility first, or funding the deposit from outside the pledged portfolio, and agreeing the order of the steps well ahead of time.

You also asked in August what happens to the Lombard line if Hong Kong property falls again. I would like to answer both questions together on a call this week, if that suits you.
draft.client_language:
[[FIRST_NAME]] 您好：

我一直在研究您預計於 2027 年初支付的土地訂金應如何籌措，當中有一個問題，我希望在日期臨近之前，由我親自告訴您。

表面上，組合足以應付：可於一日內出售的持倉約有 USD 34.0m，而未來十二個月到期的款項為 USD 10.3m。但這些持倉全部都已抵押予您的 Lombard 信貸額度。若出售其中 HKD 80.0m，銀行可貸出的價值會減少 HKD 45.3m，貸款相對該價值的比率會由 68.8% 升至約 97%，遠高於銀行必須要求您補回款項的 70% 水平。您需要在出售之前、而不是之後，先償還約 HKD 29.9m 的額度。

因此，最直接的做法——出售部分流動持倉——正正就是觸發補倉的做法。我的建議是先降低信貸額度，或以抵押組合以外的資金支付訂金，並及早商定各個步驟的先後次序。

您在八月亦問過，若香港物業再次下跌，Lombard 額度會受到甚麼影響。如您方便，我希望本週致電，把兩個問題一併向您說明。
draft.raises: Asks him to choose between reducing the Lombard facility first or funding the deposit from outside the pledged portfolio, before any sale.

draft.subject: Bonds maturing after 2036, and waiting for them to recover
draft.english:
Dear [[FIRST_NAME]],

You have told me you would rather wait for your bonds to recover than sell them at a loss, and I understand why selling can feel like admitting a mistake. I would like to put one thing alongside that view before we decide anything.

The plan we agreed is to fund your living costs until 2036. Today 41.0% of your wealth is in bonds that do not repay until after that date, and together they are about USD 2.8m below what was paid for them. The largest is the Japan Government Bond 1.4% due 2044. The only point at which these bonds are certain to repay in full is when they mature, and for these that is well beyond the period the money is meant to cover.

Selling at a loss would not be admitting a mistake; it would be moving money to where it can actually be used. What I would suggest is that we look at shortening the maturities step by step, so that what you need to draw comes due when you need it, rather than all at once.

May I call you this week to go through it together?
draft.client_language:
[[FIRST_NAME]] 様

債券は損失を出して売却するよりも回復を待ちたい、売却は過ちを認めることのように感じる、とのお考えを伺っております。そのお気持ちはよく理解しております。何かを決める前に、ひとつだけ併せてご覧いただきたいことがございます。

お約束したプランでは、2036 年までの生活費をまかなうことになっております。現在、ご資産の 41.0% はその時点より後に償還を迎える債券で運用されており、合計で取得価格を約 USD 2.8m 下回っております。最も大きいのは Japan Government Bond 1.4% due 2044 です。これらの債券が確実に全額償還されるのは満期の時点だけであり、その時期は資金が必要とされる期間を大きく超えております。

損失を出して売却することは、過ちを認めることではなく、資金を実際に使える場所へ移すことだと考えております。ご提案としては、償還時期を段階的に短くし、お引き出しが必要な時期に必要な資金が満期を迎えるようにすることを、ご一緒に検討できればと存じます。

今週中にお電話にてご説明させていただいてもよろしいでしょうか。
draft.raises: Asks him to consider shortening the bond maturities step by step so they fall due when the money is needed.
